title: The Life Of Pablo
description: Kanye compared himself to artist Pablo Picasso, infamous drug lord Pablo Escobar and poet Pablo Neruda. With this in mind, people began wondering which of the three Pablos was Kanye referring to in the album title. The album artwork might represent the dichotomy between Kanye, the faithful family man (emphasis on faithful, as it covers both the denotation and faith in God), and Kanye being tempted by worldly pleasures such as big booty women.
people: Joe Perez, Mark Seekings & Peter De Potter

title: Watch The Throne
description:
Tracklist for the album played during the private listening party given to journalists and two people who preordered the album. "Primetime" and "Illest Mothafucka Alive" were played after the main tracklist, since they were likely going to be bonus tracks. "That's My Bitch" was described to have been being "mastered by Q-Tip" at the time by MIKE DEAN, so whether it was planned as a bonus track is unknown. "H.A.M." was also in limbo on whether or not it was going to be a bonus track. Said to be the third rendition of the album.

title: ✨ Forever [V3]
description: Originally thought to have been the outro for "Pressure", but it's unrelated entirely. Likely from early 2015 as Kanye was working closely with Rihanna and Keyon Christ on her album, as well as it being ripped from the same CD as "Pick Up Your Speed" - possibly a CD of references for Rihanna - when sent to Christina Aguilera. There are acapella and instrumental files from July 2015, but those were likely bounced to send to Darren King and other producers. The song title was confirmed when Keyon Christ referred to the snippet that leaked with Kanye vox as "#Forever". Keyon later released a version of the instrumental on SoundCloud.

title: YEEZY POWERPHASE
description: Designed by Kanye West, the Yeezy Powerphase Calabasas 'Core Black' is a minimalist take on adidas' Powerphase sneaker from the 80s. Dressed in an all-black leather upper with matching laces, the lateral side is accented by gold ‘Calabasas’ print and green 'adidas' text alongside a red Trefoil logo. A black EVA midsole and rubber outsole complete the look. Released as part of the 'Calabasas' collection, other colorways include 'Core White' and 'Grey'.

title: YEEZY BOOST 380 INFANTS
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 380 Infants ‘Alien Blue’ utilizes a flexible Primeknit upper in a subtle blend of cream and grey hues. A fluorescent shade of green distinguishes the monofilament window that’s woven into the side panel, improving the shoe’s breathability while adding a see-through design element to the sock-like build. No-tie laces and a stretchy knit collar allow for easy on and off. The sneaker is mounted on a full-length Boost midsole, wrapped in a blue-tinged rubber cage and supported underfoot by a herringbone-traction outsole.
